audit.why: TRICKY 7.5/10 fits 52.5%: levels 1-2 are genuinely dangerous against a fury-stacked Renekton, and everything after is Poppy's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Renekton, Renekton, Skill, Skill, Renekton, Renekton in both layers. The packet has Renekton, Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy, and all seven whys already describe the packet's answer.
audit.why: whys[2] literally says you ground his Slice and wall-stun him on a row printed as Renekton, and whys[6] says he falls off hard while you stay relevant on another Renekton row. Every row disagreed with its own explanation.
audit.corrected: All seven rows re-proposed as one atomic paired group in both layers: Renekton, Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy, Poppy. Ratings realigned to 3/5/6/6/6/6/7.

audit.whatIsWrong: Empowered Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields on the target, and the page never says so — while Poppy's entire early defence is the Iron Ambassador buckler shield. His W is also an auto-attack reset, and Cull the Meek heals him on a 7s cooldown with no anti-heal timing given.
audit.why: A player holding the buckler as protection loses it outright to a fury-empowered W, and the 1.5s stun that follows is the whole trade. Steadfast Presence stopping Slice and Dice is correct and stays — that part of the page is right.
audit.corrected: Shield destruction, the reset tell, and Grievous Wounds timing all added; the W cooldown (16-8s) and both stun durations stated.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ruthless Predator's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.

edits.after: Dominus gives health and fury, not a kill button. Keeper's Verdict flings him clean out of his own all-in — this window stays yours.

edits.before: Renekton owns the first two levels — his full-fury W stun and dash-in combo can chunk you before you have Q+E to answer. Don't walk up to last-hit into a fury-stacked Renekton; take the CS hit and farm with Q's delayed fissure from range. At level 3 the lane shifts: hold W so that when he Slices in (E) you ground the dash, then E him into a wall for a stun he can't fury-cancel.
edits.after: Renekton owns the first two levels — above 50 fury his Ruthless Predator stuns 1.5s and destroys your buckler shield, so the passive you were counting on is not there. Don't walk up to last-hit into a fury-stacked Renekton; take the CS hit and farm with Q's delayed fissure. At level 3 the lane shifts: hold W so that when he Slices in (E, 16-10s) you stop the dash cold, then E him into a wall.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are yours. Every engage he has runs through a dash — his E-in — and your W shuts it off cold, grounding him mid-Slice and leaving him standing in your face for a Q chunk and an E wall-slam. Bait the W stun, weave back, and punish the fury-empty window. At 6 your R is pure insurance: tap-knockup or fling him out of his own all-in if he ever catches you cornered.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are yours. Every engage runs through Slice and Dice, and your W shuts it off cold, grounding him mid-dash and leaving him in your face for a Q chunk and an E wall-slam. Bait the W stun, weave back, and punish the fury-empty window — and get Grievous Wounds in, because Cull the Meek heals him every 7s through your chip. At 6 your R is insurance: fling him out of his own all-in if he corners you.

edits.before: This is a blowout in your favor. Renekton's whole kit is front-loaded — once he's past his fury-combo window his flat damage does nothing, while your max-HP Q keeps chunking and your W keeps eating his only engage tool. Don't let him split freely with a lead; group, W-deny his dash onto your carries, and E-wall-stun him out of every fight. He cannot kill you and you stay relevant when he doesn't.
edits.after: This is a blowout in your favor. Renekton's kit is front-loaded — past his fury window his flat damage does nothing, while your max-HP Q keeps chunking and your W keeps eating Slice and Dice, the only engage he owns. Don't let him split freely with a lead; group, stop his dash onto your carries, and E-wall-stun him out of every fight. Anti-heal stays in the build so his Q sustain never carries a long fight.

notes: No mirror existed, so these findings are first-hand. The most valuable omission: empowered Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields on the target, which means it deletes Poppy's Iron Ambassador buckler — the exact defence the early-game advice tells the player to rely on. Added alongside the 1.5s empowered stun, the auto-reset tell, and Grievous Wounds timing for Cull the Meek's 7s heal. The chart was wrong in all seven rows against its own whys and a 579-game packet; re-proposed as one atomic paired group. Correct and kept: Slice and Dice is a dash, so Steadfast Presence genuinely stops it — this is one of the matchups where Poppy's W active decides the lane. breakdown.trading and report[3].t still carry the generic 'W any dash he tries' line.
